title: Remote Many
subtitle: Let Dome Companion control this Mac's Many. Execution stays local; the cloud only relays encrypted envelopes.
enable_desc: Desktop keeps an outgoing connection to Dome Provider. Companion can chat only while this Mac is awake and Dome is open.
status_offline: Offline — Companion cannot send until this Mac is awake
refresh_desc: Reload pairing and presence from Provider.
pair_desc: Generate a code in Dome, then enter it in Companion → Account. Codes expire in 10 minutes.
pair_requires_enable: Turn on remote control first to generate a code.

errors.desktop_unavailable: This Mac is not registered with Dome yet. Check that you are signed in to your Dome account and try again.
errors.companion_unavailable: That iPhone is no longer available. Open Companion and pair again.
errors.pairing_code_invalid: The code is invalid or has expired. Generate a new one.
errors.pairing_inactive: This pairing is no longer active. Generate a new code.
errors.device_kind_conflict: This device is already registered with a different role. Revoke it and try again.
errors.unauthorized: Your Dome session expired. Sign in again under Settings → Dome Sync.
errors.network: Could not reach Dome. Check your connection and try again.
